topic:
Research how Notion's UI for the calendar view (month grid, week and day scales, chips, multi-day spans, today, navigation, unscheduled items, date-property pickers, phone calendar) should refine the note-database Obsidian plugin's surface, using the Notion screen digest at specs/005-component-surface-system/057-calendar-anytype-parity/notion-screens-digest.md as the ONLY source of Notion facts (it was written by an image-capable analyst from the Mobbin captures; you cannot read PNG files — never open image files), against our implementation and design record: src/views/calendar-renderer.ts, src/views/calendar-toolbar-renderer.ts, the calendar blocks of styles.css, specs/005-component-surface-system/057-calendar-anytype-parity/{goal.md,design-trueup.md,review-ui-calendar-2026-09-06.md,decision-record.md,tasks.md,acceptance-criteria.md}, specs/005-component-surface-system/design-system.md, and roadmap.md section 6A rulings.

Bounded scope: read those files and nothing beyond them unless a finding requires one more source file.

Operator context: Anytype parity is the default ruling for these surfaces (051 ADR-007, 056, 057); Notion refinements are additive — where Notion and Anytype disagree, name the conflict and propose which to adopt with the reason, never override a landed operator ruling.

Questions to answer with file:line and screen-id evidence:
1. Which Notion patterns from the digest would improve this surface for a user (rank by user impact)?
2. For each, the concrete change to our code and CSS (file, rule/function, value) and its measurable threshold.
3. Which Notion behaviours do we already have?
4. Which conflict with an Anytype ruling?
5. Which need a device-only check?
6. A ranked remediation plan as concrete phase tasks with thresholds and red-first checks suitable for a new child phase.

Cite every claim; mark inferences as inferences. Never edit src/, styles.css or tools/ — this is a research-only run.
